prerequisites: All subjects from lower years must be passed or currently enrolled in.

learning_outcomes.text: Know and apply computational 2D and 3D modeling techniques to mechanical design.
Know and apply computational techniques for generating documentation for manufacturing, assembly, and operation of machines and industrial constructions.
Know and apply computational techniques for classic machine design calculations.
Know and apply computational numerical analysis techniques in machine design.

assessment_methods.method: Practice report, practicum and external practices report

assessment_rules: The course is passed if a final grade equal to or greater than five is obtained, considering lab attendance, practice reports, and supervised work. Part of the exam may be replaced by additional activities and/or assignments. Students not following continuous assessment will take a different exam covering all course material. Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices, etc.) will result in a failing grade of 0.0 for the academic year.
